Definition: from the base of G2255 and G5610; a half-hour:--half an hour.
BiblicalUsage: Hemiorion is half an hour, and it appears once, in the silence before the trumpets. In Revelation 8:1 there is silence in heaven about the space of half an hour when the seventh seal is opened.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the half hour is the most solemn silence in the Bible: heaven itself stops to listen before the judgment begins.
